title: Harness Hub 0.2.0 sync and host compatibility
summary: Updated the local Harness Hub source checkout to origin/main at 8ac264bed8a06fc6bf954a88ad92330e13e63e03, refreshed the Codex skill aggregation, curated the new harness-quality-check and insight capabilities for Claude Code, and promoted .claude/skills from local ignored state to a tracked repository artifact while preserving local Codex overlays.

validation_commands: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p=['.codex/skills/insight/SKILL.md','.claude/skills/insight/SKILL.md','.codex/skills/harness-quality-check/SKILL.md','.claude/skills/harness-quality-check/SKILL.md']; const missing=p.filter((x)=>!fs.existsSync(x)); if (missing.length){ console.error('missing '+missing.join(',')); process.exit(1); }"

node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const manifest=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.codex/harness-hub-aggregation.json','utf8')); for (const skill of ['insight','harness-quality-check']) if (!manifest.importedSkills.includes(skill)) { console.error('manifest missing '+skill); process.exit(1); } console.log(manifest.source.commit);"

lessons.lesson: Harness Hub skill sync needs a separate Claude Code curation pass.
lessons.evidence: The existing update script refreshed .codex/skills and the aggregation manifest, but .claude/skills stayed outside the tracked aggregation path and had to be curated from the active Codex skill tree.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep Claude Code compatibility checks in the maintenance validation checklist whenever Harness Hub imports or updates standard skills.

lessons.lesson: PowerShell Copy-Item with -LiteralPath does not expand wildcard source paths.
lessons.evidence: The first Claude curation attempt created empty insight and harness-quality-check directories; the targeted skills test failed until Copy-Item used -Path for wildcard expansion.
lessons.recommended_action: Use explicit directory copy commands or -Path wildcard expansion for mechanical curation, then run file-existence tests before handoff.

suggestions.issue: Claude Code curated skills are maintained as local ignored state rather than the lock-backed Codex aggregation.
suggestions.evidence: The user confirmed .claude should be tracked; the local .git/info/exclude entry was removed, .claude/skills files were staged, and tests/skills.test.js now asserts representative Claude Code curated skill files are returned by git ls-files.
suggestions.suggestion: Keep Claude Code curated skills as tracked repository artifacts and validate representative tracked files in the skill test suite.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Future Harness Hub updates would have a deterministic Codex and Claude Code compatibility path instead of relying on manual local curation.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented in this project_iteration by tracking .claude/skills and adding a git ls-files regression test.

followups.action: Promote .claude/skills to a tracked sync surface with representative git ls-files validation.
